sources.name: Coaching: our business
sources.text: Green Leaf Coaching offers one-to-one life and career coaching for young professionals in Colombo.

sources.name: Coaching: session arrangements
sources.text: Sessions are 45 minutes, online or at our Colombo studio, before or after work hours.

sources.name: Coaching: coaches and focus
sources.text: Our coaches are certified and focus on confidence, sustainable habits and work-life balance.

sources.name: Coaching: programmes
sources.text: Programmes: Starter (4 sessions), Growth (8 sessions) and Leadership (12 sessions).

sources.name: Coaching: current offer
sources.text: Current offer: Your first session is free for new clients. No promo code is needed. There is no end date.

sources.name: Coaching: referral
sources.text: Refer a friend and you both get one free session.

briefs.name: Welcome / first session
briefs.goal: Invite young professionals to book their free first coaching session and explain how coaching can help with career confidence.

briefs.name: Re-engage past clients
briefs.goal: Re-engage past clients who have not booked a session in three months and invite them back to the Growth programme.
briefs.audience: Past clients who completed the Starter programme

briefs.name: Referral
briefs.goal: Encourage current clients to refer a friend so both get one free session.
briefs.audience: Active clients in the Growth programme

briefs.name: No-offer guardrail test
briefs.goal: Introduce our evening online coaching sessions to busy managers.
briefs.audience: Mid-career managers with long working hours

sources.name: Realty: our business

sources.name: Realty: client service
sources.text: Every client gets a dedicated agent and help with bank loan paperwork.

sources.name: Realty: current offer

briefs.name: Free property valuation

legacy_gym_sources: Green Leaf Coaching uses an encouraging, science-backed tone. We emphasise sustainable habits, community, and evidence-based wellness.
Membership tiers: Basic $29/mo (gym floor weekdays), Premium $59/mo (adds classes + app), Elite $99/mo (adds personal training).
Target audience: Young professionals aged 25-35 who want efficient 45-minute workouts before or after work. They value convenience, results, and community.
Key benefits: State-of-the-art equipment refreshed yearly, certified trainers, flexible freeze options, guest passes, towel service, parking.
October 2026 promotions: First month free for new members. Refer a friend and earn $20 credit. No joining fee this month.
